{{Quote|We're hitting it with everything we have, but the Indomitable won't be stopped.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoge]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>}}
The '''''Indomitable''''' was a [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|MC140 ''Scythe''-class battle cruiser]] serving the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] from at least [[130 ABY]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is the Galactic Alliance Cruiser Indomitable. Captain Jaius Yorub commanding. Though battles have been lost, the Alliance still lives. We have not surrendered, we do not concede the stars. We will win back our birthright. ''Freedom''.|Jaius Yorub's final words|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 21" />}}
''Indomitable'' was the flagship of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and the symbol of power of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. After the [[Battle of Caamas]], during which the Galactic Alliance was defeated by the Empire, it became the flagship of the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]].

[[File:Indomitable_go_smash.jpg|thumb|left|''Indomitable'' being destroyed during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]].]]
After seven years of attacks on [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], the ''Indomitable'' saw its last fight at the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]]. After being outmaneuvered by Stazi, Admiral [[Dru Valan]] ordered his battered fleet to destroy the ''Indomitable'' at all costs. When the rest of the Alliance fleet had fled the system on Stazi's orders, he ordered the ship to be evacuated so he could ram it into the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]], but was knocked out by [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Jhoram Bey]]. Instead, it was the ship's captain and Stazi's second-in-command, [[Jaius Yorub]], who piloted the ship into the shipyards. He was killed in the attack, but managed to destroy a third of the shipyards while damaging another quarter.

The ''Indomitable'' was later replaced as flagship by the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']].
